title: Branch Head ( Pudussery, Chentrappini)
description:
**Organization:** KLM Axiva Finvest ltd

We are seeking an experienced and motivated **Branch Manager** to do our branch operations at **Thrissur region**. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in the NBFC or financial services sector, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for achieving business goals while ensuring superior customer service.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Minimum **3\+ years experience** in an NBFC or similar financial institution
* Strong background in **sales, marketing, and business development**
* Exceptional customer service skills with the ability to handle customer queries effectively
* Ability to manage daily branch operations and ensure smooth workflow
* Strong communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to guide and assist walk\-in customers with professionalism
* Good understanding of financial products, lending operations, and market dynamics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee overall branch operations, ensuring efficient functioning and compliance
* Handle customer queries, resolve concerns, and ensure high customer satisfaction
* Maintain and expand customer relationships within the local market
* Ensure proper documentation, reporting, and adherence to company policies
* Monitor branch performance and develop strategies for continuous improvement.

**Why Join KLM Axiva Finvest Ltd?**

* Opportunity to lead and grow a branch in a reputed NBFC
* Performance\-driven growth and career advancement
* Professional work environment with strong organizational support

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
Digital Marketing Intern – SEO / Meta AdsJob Type

We are looking for **2 Digital Marketing Interns** to join our team. The selected candidates will work in one of two areas based on their skills and interest:

**1\. SEO Intern**  
**2\. Meta Ads / Performance Marketing Intern**

This is a hands\-on internship for candidates who want to build practical experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, lead generation, and organic growth.

Key ResponsibilitiesSEO Intern

* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Assist with on\-page SEO and website content optimization.
* Optimize meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal links.
* Conduct basic SEO audits and identify improvement opportunities.
* Assist with off\-page SEO and link\-building activities.
* Monitor keyword rankings and organic traffic.
* Assist with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Research SEO trends, search intent, and content opportunities.
* Work with the content and marketing teams to improve organic visibility.

Meta Ads / Performance Marketing Intern

* Assist in setting up and managing Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
* Conduct audience research and assist with targeting.
* Support lead generation campaigns and campaign monitoring.
* Track key performance metrics such as **CPL, CTR, CPM, leads, and conversions**.
* Assist with testing different audiences, creatives, and ad copies.
* Analyze campaign performance and identify optimization opportunities.
* Conduct competitor and market research.
* Coordinate with the content and graphic design teams for ad creatives.
* Prepare basic campaign performance reports.
* Stay updated with Meta Ads and performance marketing trends.

Requirements

* Freshers and candidates with **0–1 year of experience** can apply.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing.
* Strong interest in either **SEO or Meta Ads / Performance Marketing**.
* Good analytical and research skills.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn and take feedback.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and meet deadlines.

Additional Skills

For the **SEO track**, knowledge of:

* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics
* Keyword research tools
* On\-page SEO

will be an advantage.

For the **Meta Ads track**, knowledge of:

* Meta Ads Manager
* Lead generation campaigns
* Audience targeting
* Campaign metrics and optimization

will be an advantage.

Preferred Candidates

* Students, freshers, or aspiring digital marketers.
* Candidates who have completed a **Digital Marketing or SEO course/certification**.
* Candidates with personal projects, freelance experience, college projects, blogs, websites, or previous campaign experience are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates interested in building a career in **SEO, Meta Ads, Performance Marketing, Lead Generation, or Digital Marketing**.

What You Will Gain

* Hands\-on experience with real digital marketing campaigns.
* Practical exposure to **SEO and/or Meta Ads**.
* Experience working with marketing and creative teams.
* Understanding of campaign performance and reporting.
* Opportunity to develop practical digital marketing skills.

**Note:** We are hiring **2 interns** — one for **SEO** and one for **Meta Ads / Performance Marketing**. Candidates can mention their preferred area of specialization when applying.

Pay: ₹8,086\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off

title: E-commerce & Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Looking for a **part\-time or Fulltime executive** who is interested in building hands\-on experience in **E\-commerce, Digital Marketing and Online Business Growth**.

You’ll work from my office in **Aluva** and take responsibility for managing our e\-commerce activities while supporting the digital marketing and growth of the business.

What You’ll Work On

**E\-commerce Management**

* Manage products, listings, pricing and inventory on our online platforms
* Process and coordinate online orders
* Monitor order status, fulfilment and customer updates
* Maintain product information, images and content

**Digital Marketing \& Social Media**

* Manage social media pages and regular content updates
* Create and publish posts, reels and promotional content
* Support digital campaigns and online promotions
* Assist with basic SEO, lead generation and website updates
* Track engagement, enquiries and campaign performance

**Business \& Operations Support**

* Coordinate with suppliers for product availability and pricing
* Assist with purchasing and stock updates
* Coordinate local deliveries and order fulfilment when required
* Handle customer enquiries and follow\-ups

**Business Growth**

* Explore marketplaces and online sales opportunities
* Support seasonal campaigns and product launches
* Identify practical ways to increase online sales and customer reach

You **don’t need extensive experience**. Freshers and candidates with relevant experience are welcome.

What matters more is:

* Willingness to learn and take initiative
* Basic understanding of social media and digital platforms
* Interest in e\-commerce and online business
* Good communication and follow\-up skills

**Location:** Aluva, Kerala

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job ID \- **1112**


### **Job Description**

**Job Summary**


We are looking for a Market Analyst who can support business, sales, and marketing decisions through strong market research and data analytics.

  

The role involves studying industries, identifying target customer segments, analysing competitors, building lead databases, tracking market trends, and converting raw data into clear business insights. The candidate should be able to work with research data, sales data, marketing performance data, and customer information to support strategy, campaigns, and business growth.

  

This role is not limited to preparing reports. We are looking for someone who can understand the market, identify opportunities, analyse patterns, and present insights that help the company take better decisions.

 **Skills Required**

**Market Research \& Opportunity Analysis**


Industry research, competitor benchmarking, market gap analysis, pricing research, TAM/SAM/SOM, ICP creation, customer segmentation, geography mapping, and opportunity mapping.

**Data Analytics \& Insight Generation**


Data collection, data cleaning, data validation, data interpretation, trend analysis, correlation analysis, forecasting basics, and business insight generation.

**Sales, Marketing \& Customer Analytics**


Lead source analysis, campaign performance analysis, funnel analysis, conversion tracking, CAC analysis, pipeline analysis, customer acquisition trends, retention analysis, churn analysis.

 **Tools**

**Data \& Analytics Tools:** Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio.

**Research \& Market Intelligence Tools:** Google Trends, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Crunchbase, MCA Data, ZaubaCorp, industry reports, company websites, and public databases.

**Digital \& Marketing Analytics Tools:** Google Analytics, social media analytics platforms, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Analytics, YouTube Analytics.

 **Education**


MBA in Marketing, Business Analytics, Strategy, or related fields preferred.


Candidates with a background in BBA, B.Com, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or Computer Applications can also apply if they have strong analytical and research skills.

  

Experience: 0\-4 years
